output.reason: [ev-b9ece170da60] presents this as a new capability, and nothing in it says anything fails or that operators must act, so no failure kind fits. But it never says how 1.12 generated ValidatingAdmissionPolicies when a validate.cel policy had a matching PolicyException, or when a policy targeted a single namespace. It also says such policies "will now" get a VAP with matchConstraints.namespaceSelector, which suggests existing generated VAPs could change on upgrade (behavior-change) rather than this being purely opt-in (none). To settle none versus behavior-change, we need 1.12 release notes, docs or code showing what was generated before (no VAP, a VAP without exclusions, or no namespace scoping).
